problems.problem: With downstream positive, drift should be +s × t_min; the minus sign contradicts the stated sign convention.
problems.verifierReason: Minus sign contradicts 'downstream' label; correction fixes sign.

problems.quote: If s > b, the boat cannot cancel the drift; the minimum drift is achieved by pointing straight upstream (θ = 90°), but the boat will still be carried downstream.
problems.problem: Pointing straight upstream gives zero across-river component, so the boat never crosses. Minimum drift while crossing occurs at sin θ = b/s.
problems.correction: If s > b, the boat cannot cancel the drift; the minimum drift while crossing is achieved at sin θ = b/s, giving drift = w√(s²–b²)/b.
problems.verifierReason: Pointing straight upstream yields zero across-component; min drift while crossing at sin θ=b/s.
